title: Upcoming expiration of Developer ID Certification Authority (Sub-CA)
description: The original Developer ID Certification Authority (Sub-CA) expires on February 1, 2027. Certificates issued by this authority will stop working on that date. What to do: Check if you’re affected. In Certificates, Identifiers Profiles , look for certificates expiring on or before February 1, 2027. See Replacing Developer ID certificates issued from the previous Sub-CA for help identifying your certificate’s authority. Create a new certificate. Generate a replacement from the current authority, Developer ID Certification Authority (G2). Note: This certificate authority is valid until 2031, but the certificates issued by the certificate authority expire annually and must be renewed each year. summary_ja: 2027年2月1日にDeveloper ID認証局（Sub-CA）が失効するため、この認証局から発行された証明書は使用不可になります。Apple Developer Programのメンバーは、Certificate, Identifiers & Profilesで失効予定の証明書を確認し、現在の認証局「Developer ID Certification Authority (G2)」から新しい証明書を生成する必要があります。新しい証明書の有効期限は2031年までですが、発行された証明書は毎年更新が必要です。
